title: Rex and the Hammer Song
synopsis: Rex listens to the carpenter’s tools from a safe distance while the adult crew fastens the replacement roof and makes a flashing-and-gutter path for rain. A hen provides the loudest inspection of all.
continuity_state: Before: The adult crew has completed and braced the shelter framing. A yellow telehandler placed secured roofing supplies on the working platform and has returned to its work base; the roof is not yet sealed or ready for rain. After: Mr. Lee and crew have installed and secured the small shelter roof panels, wall-to-roof flashing, edge gutter and short downspout toward a stone splash area away from the wagon-door approach. Inspection remains to be completed and the first real rainfall has not tested it. The work barrier remains up until Farmer Ruth confirms completion.
